facts.fact: AGETIC's board presented a 2025 budget of 2,986,779 (FCFA thousand, near 3 billion FCFA), as the ministry's secretary general said.
The AGETIC 2025 budget is up 2.51 per cent, or 73,272,000 FCFA, on the year before.

facts.fact: AGETIC continued work on the administration intranet, including maintenance and extension of the network to new structures and deploying applications.
AGETIC, the state ICT agency, builds and runs the administration intranet and applications interconnecting public services.
